transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been having trouble at work, at the register. I’ll get stuck doing things that don’t really fit what’s happening—like tapping the scanner in a pattern, or I’ll freeze with my hand over the cash drawer while the customer is just standing there waiting. Last week it got me written up, so… I figured I needed to talk to someone.
Do you find yourself doing these patterns or rituals outside of work as well?

Mostly it’s been happening at work, at the register. That’s where I notice it the most—like I’ll start tapping the scanner in a certain pattern, or I’ll just freeze with my hand over the cash drawer even though the customer is waiting. I can’t really explain why I do it, but it throws me off, and that’s what got me written up last week.
Do you have any recurring thoughts that bother you or feel intrusive?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I have thoughts that keep coming back and bother me like that. It’s more like I just get caught in the moment and my body does the thing, if that makes sense.
Do you feel anxious when these patterns or rituals happen, or when you're unable to do them?

I don’t know if I’d call it anxious. I’m more confused or frustrated when it happens, especially if someone’s waiting on me. If I can’t do it, I don’t really notice a big fear or panic feeling. It’s just like I get stuck for a moment.
Did you experience any difficulties or delays in your development as a child, such as with speech, movement, or social interactions?

I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having any big delays like that, at least nothing anyone told me about. I think I did okay in school and growing up, but I’d have to ask someone in my family to know for sure.
Do you find yourself repeating certain behaviors or movements when you're not at work?

Yeah, sometimes. It’s not only at work, but that’s where it’s causing the biggest problem. At the register I’ll get stuck doing something that doesn’t really make sense for the situation, like tapping the scanner in a pattern, or I’ll just freeze with my hand over the cash drawer while the customer is standing there waiting. Last week I got written up for it.
Did you have strong, specific interests as a child that you felt very passionate about?
I don’t really know. I probably had things I liked, like most kids, but I don’t remember having one big interest that took over everything. Nothing really stands out to me that way.
Have you ever had trouble making friends or feeling like you fit in with your peers?

I’m not really sure. I wasn’t the most outgoing person, but I did have some people I talked to. I don’t remember feeling like it was a major problem, but I also wasn’t someone who fit in easily with everybody.
Do you have trouble understanding why people react to you in certain ways, or understanding sarcasm and jokes?
I’m not sure. I mean, sometimes I don’t know why someone gets annoyed with me, but I wouldn’t say I can’t understand jokes or sarcasm in general. I guess it depends on the person and the situation.
Did you exhibit repetitive behaviors, like hand flapping or body rocking, when you were a child?
I don’t really know. I don’t remember doing things like hand flapping or rocking. No one in my family ever mentioned that to me, at least not that I can recall.
Do you have any strong, highly specific interests that you enjoy spending a lot of time thinking about or doing?
Not really, no. I mean, I have things I like doing, but I don’t think there’s anything unusually specific that I spend all my time on. Nothing that stands out to me like that.
Do you often find it hard to start or maintain conversations with others?

Yeah, I do. I mean, I can answer if someone talks to me, but starting a conversation takes a lot out of me. Even with my wife and kids, I still care about them, but I don’t have much push to call my son at college or meet up with people from the kayak group.

And when someone asks me what’s wrong, I usually just kind of shrug. I can’t find much to say.
Do you have difficulty understanding other people's perspectives or feelings?

I’m not sure. I don’t think I usually have trouble understanding what people are feeling, but I guess sometimes I don’t pick up on it unless they say it directly. I haven’t really noticed it as a major problem.
Do you have any activities or hobbies that you feel compelled to do in a very specific way?
No, I don’t think so. I have routines, I guess, like anyone, but I don’t feel like I have to do a hobby or activity in one exact way. Nothing like that really comes to mind.
Do you feel like you have to follow a specific daily routine, and if it's disrupted, it causes you distress?
Not really, no. I mean, I have a usual way I go through the day, but if something changes, I don’t think it makes me especially upset. I just… deal with it, I guess.
Did you ever feel like you had to collect or hoard certain objects as a child?
No, I don’t think so. I don’t remember collecting or hoarding things like that when I was a kid. I might’ve kept normal stuff, but nothing I felt I had to hold onto.
Do you feel like you have to do things in a certain order or way, even when it's not necessary?
No, not really. I don’t feel like I have to do things in a special order or a certain way. I might have habits, but if I do something differently, it doesn’t really bother me.
Did you exhibit any repetitive behaviors as a child, such as repeating words or phrases, that your family or friends noticed?
I don’t think so. I don’t remember my family or friends saying I repeated words or phrases a lot as a kid. Not that I know of.
Do you feel like you have limited or no variation in your daily activities or interests outside of work?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean, I still care about my wife and my kids, but outside of work I don’t really do much anymore. I don’t have the push to call my son at college, or meet up with the kayak group, or even work on my little repair projects at home. People ask me what’s wrong and I mostly just shrug, because I don’t really know what to say.
Do you have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and are difficult to control?
I’m not sure. I don’t really notice thoughts repeating like that, or like I’m stuck on them and can’t stop. My mind wanders sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it’s the same thought over and over.
